description: Aether canonical Rights vocabulary (Rights Authority blueprint / IRRL naming overlay). Owns the enumerated vocabularies of the structured rights contract (rights-derivation classes, learning classes, ownership classes, intelligence-rights profiles, disclosure boundaries, Olympus purposes, lifecycle actions, model revocation states, rights decision dispositions) plus the profile-default, migration, generalization and termination tables. It is a plain canonical JSON contract, not a generator registry: the Python enums in Backend Architecture/aether-backend/services/integrations/data_rights/models.py and the TS twin packages/shared/data-rights.ts are hand-authored to these EXACT snake_case values and cross-checked by scripts/validate_rights_vocabulary.py. rights-vocabulary.json adds no data-authority rows: every term below stays owned by the consent/data-rights/retention/evidence machinery; it resolves and records rights over those authorities (blueprint §13, §14).

bindings._note: Tri-surface parity contract consumed by scripts/validate_rights_vocabulary.py. A vocabulary key is either bound to its Python enum class (pythonEnum) and TS as-const array (tsArray) with EXACT member/literal equality to this JSON, or allowlisted (allowlisted: true) because it is a record/table or a vocabulary carried by a later runtime surface rather than a Phase-0 twin surface. Covering every vocabulary key here is mandatory.

rightsProfileDefaults.reason: Per-profile policy-preset record (blueprint §3.6); not a single enumerated surface — its four profile keys equal intelligenceRightsProfiles and are validated structurally.

learningAuthorityFlags.reason: The nine LearningAuthority boolean flag keys; must equal learningClasses as a set (validated structurally). No independent enum/array surface.

terminationAuthorityActions.reason: Termination artifact to blueprint-disposition table (blueprint §3.5); dispositions are lifecycle/retention strings validated structurally, not a Phase-0 twin enum.

generalizationDestinations.reason: Generalization Gateway destination vocabulary (blueprint §6); enforced by the rights_irrl-owned gateway adapter. Twin surface lands with the gateway runtime, not the Phase-0 canonical-enum surface.

generalizationTransformations.reason: Generalization Gateway transformation vocabulary (blueprint §6); enforced by the rights_irrl-owned gateway adapter. Twin surface lands with the gateway runtime, not the Phase-0 canonical-enum surface.

modelRevocationSemantics.reason: Single migration-semantics record (legacyBoolean -> mapsTo, broadens:false) cross-checked structurally against learningClasses; no enum surface.

migrationMappings.reason: Migration-map record list (legacyBoolean -> mapsTo, broadens:false); each mapsTo must be a learningClasses member and broadens must stay false. No enum surface.
